title: Add per-entry TTL to LruCache
prompt: Extend LruCache so set(key, value, { ttlMs }) makes the entry expire after ttlMs. Expired entries behave as missing for get() and has(). The constructor accepts an optional { now } clock function (default Date.now) so expiry is testable. Existing behaviour must not change for entries without a TTL.
acceptance: Expired entries return undefined from get() and false from has()
Clock is injectable via constructor option { now }
